subject: Marketplace co-sell demo — slot pivot & final runbook
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@cloudwave.com>, AWS Partner Team <aws-partner@amazon.com>, Nova Integrations <demoops@novaintegrations.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-18T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace co-sell demo — slot pivot & final runbook

Hi all,

Thanks for agreeing to run this joint marketplace co-sell demo for CloudWave + Redwood. We want to lock a final slot this week and circulate a short runbook for ops. Goal: a customer-facing 45–50 min walkthrough showcasing a multi-cloud deployment pattern, with a 10–15 min Q&A.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 9/19 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 9/20 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 9/21 08:00–09:00 PT (APAC-friendly)

Agenda (draft):
1) 5 min intros + roles
2) 20 min Redwood product walkthrough (model serving & routing)
3) 15 min CloudWave architecture + demo integration
4) 5–10 min Q&A and next steps

Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook-v2.pdf (notes + responsibilities), cloudwave-sow-draft.docx (informational).

Action items I propose:
- Elena: which slot works best for your SE + business lead?
- Nova: confirm if your SI engineer needs a pre-demo dry run (30 min) and when.
- Karthik / Soojin: ops/backups — who will be backup host and who owns infra notes?

If none of the slots work, suggest two alternatives and we’ll pivot. I’ll have the final runbook updated once we pick a slot.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0173

From: Elena Park <elena.park@cloudwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Partner Team <aws-partner@amazon.com>, Nova Integrations <demoops@novaintegrations.com>
Date: 2028-09-18T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell demo — slot pivot & final runbook

Hi Marissa — thanks. Quick notes from CloudWave side:
- Our SE (Daniel) is out Tue morning; Wed 14:00 PT works for our business lead and SE.
- Nova wants a quick pre-demo dry run (30 min) to validate network access and their automation scripts; they suggested Wed 9/20 at 13:00 PT if that’s possible.
- The APAC-friendly Thu slot is tough for our US execs.

If Wed 14:00 PT is confirmed, can we shorten the walkthrough to 40 minutes and leave 10 minutes for Q&A? That helps the exec schedule. Also can you share the Zoom link and a drivе folder for artifacts (we can push sample config there).

Attaching our topology slide for the demo context (cloudwave-topo.png).

Thanks,
Elena Park | Partnerships, CloudWave Solutions
elena.park@cloudwave.com | +1 (206) 555-0119

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@cloudwave.com>, AWS Partner Team <aws-partner@amazon.com>, Nova Integrations <demoops@novaintegrations.com>
Date: 2028-09-18T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell demo — slot pivot & final runbook

Marissa / team — Wed 9/20 14:00 PT works for me as a primary slot but I have a production oncall window 13:30–14:30 PT (may need to be muted) — I can be present but if I get paged, Soojin will need to move to host.

Operational notes:
- Backup host: Soojin (SI lead) — please confirm you’re happy to backfill hosting responsibilities.
- Fallback model: if our primary GPU pool flutters, we’ll fail over to a smaller quantized variant (will add a 1-slide note to the runbook).
- HubSpot: I updated the deal record with the proposed Wed slot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HS-58492 — please leave final confirmation there so CS can prep.

I’ll also create the Zoom meeting and post the link into the runbook; I have a meeting template that includes recording + local recording permissions for CloudWave.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Partner Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@cloudwave.com>, Nova Integrations <demoops@novaintegrations.com>, AWS Partner Team <aws-partner@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-09-18T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell demo — slot pivot & final runbook

Confirming: I can be backup host for Wed 9/20 14:00 PT. A few practical items from the SI side:
- Would prefer we trim the full walkthrough to 40 minutes (20 Redwood / 15 CloudWave / 5 Q&A) so the execs can join and leave on time.
- Nova needs us to open port 443 to their test agent from the staging subnet and provide the test account credentials (they’ll use a short-lived key). I’ll add the sample script to the Drive folder.
- Please include a single topology slide early in the deck (Elena’s attached image is perfect).

Attaching: cloudwave-topo.png (from Elena) — I adjusted the caption in the runbook.

Also: I can take ownership of infra notes in the runbook and will add failover steps. If we confirm Wed 14:00 PT, I’ll be the contact for the 13:00 pre-demo dry run with Nova.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee | SI Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-09-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell demo — slot pivot & final runbook

Thanks — Wed 9/20 14:00 PT is locked. Final plan and quick action list below:

Confirmed schedule:
- 13:00 PT: Pre-demo dry run (30 min) — Nova + Soojin (testing network & agent)
- 14:00–14:40 PT: Customer-facing demo (40 min) — 20 min Redwood, 15 min CloudWave, 5 min Q&A

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: finalize runbook and attach redwood-demo-runbook-v3.pdf to folder; post Zoom link (record enabled).
- Soojin: infra/failover notes + confirm port access for Nova by EOD Tue (13:00 PT test).
- Elena: confirm SE + exec names for calendar invite and any embargoed talking points.
- Karthik: monitor oncall overlap and be available to take over if needed.

Links: HubSpot deal (HS-58492), Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-runbooks), DocuSign NDA for the demo recordings: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/1234abcd

I’ve attached the updated runbook (redwood-demo-runbook-v3.pdf) with the condensed agenda and failover slide. Please review and call out any changes by EOD. I’ll send the calendar invite in the next 20 minutes.

—Marissa
